svg.title: Capptus — The Living Oasis, creative territory 02
svg.desc: Original supplied Capptus logo preserved as an embedded image. Baja imagery, editorial serif typography, brand blue and gray, bold, playful ink illustration, a homepage specimen, and a proposed three-state motion study.
svg.text: A brand world around the logo we keep.
Cardón silhouettes. Mineral textures. Space to breathe.
RESILIENT BY NATURE. CURIOUS BY DESIGN.
Editorial type + a human line + an unexpected response.
Original blue and gray sampled from the supplied logo.
A tide-like reveal. A growing line. One moment of surprise.
Calm content, with personality in the transitions.
YOUR DIGITAL OASIS, WITH MORE ROOM TO PLAY.
Original logo unchanged · AI-generated concept imagery
